name: vm
description: An incus guest — system container or KVM virtual machine — plus the cloud-init user-data that makes it reachable over SSH, and only the irreducibly one-shot part of that
instructions: Host-converging module: apply talks to an incus daemon through `../incus-core`, which shells out through `../host-exec`. Needs incus installed and the invoking user able to `sudo incus`. Declares creation and the config a running guest can be converged to; what happens *inside* the guest is `vm-provision`'s. `target: { remote, project }` sends the same declaration at a remote daemon over mTLS — absent means the local one, so an existing declaration keeps its meaning.
